_comment: Template for hf_config.json. Copy this file to 'hf_config.json' (it is gitignored) and fill in what you need. 'hf_token' is OPTIONAL: it is only needed for gated repos (e.g. Gemma, Llama). Create a free token at https://huggingface.co/settings/tokens (scope: read). Leave model_dir empty to use the LM Studio / Bionic default: ~/.lmstudio/models . Keep hf_config.json private - it is gitignored for a reason.
